title: The Old Wars: A First Blooding

texts.details:
Ye hit the dummy fine. The dummy doesn't hit back, an' it's got no friends.

Before I teach ye another thing, I want to know what ye do when somethin's tryin' to kill ye. The Frostmane are camped out west, past the lake. Take six o' their headhunters. One at a time if ye can manage it, an' learn what happens when ye can't.

There's one among them the mountaineers call Zal'nok. Bigger than the rest, an' fond o' the fact. Bring him down, $N. Then we'll talk about war.
texts.objectives: Kill 6 Frostmane Headhunters and then Zal'nok, at the troll camps west of Kharanos. Return to your trainer when it is done.
texts.progress: Keep your feet under ye. A warrior who falls over is supper.
texts.completion:
Zal'nok's dead? Good. An' ye're still standin', which is the first test an' the only one that counts.

Now listen. Everything ye'll ever do wi' an axe was learned by someone, in one o' the wars this world's had. First, Second, Third: we number them, as though that made them tidy. A warrior who doesn't know those wars is only a body wi' a sharp bit o' iron.

So that's how I'll have ye taught. One war at a time, by them as fought it. Take your pick o' these. When ye've twenty seasons o' sense, go to Marshal Marris in Lakeshire, in the Redridge Mountains. He was there for the first.

idea: The Old Wars, level 10 (Alliance): the warrior's first real fight, against one the trainer names. Invented: Zal'nok.
